lesson: In apply_discounts, multiple percentage discounts must compound sequentially on the running amount rather than being summed together.
why: Summing percentages caused two 50% off coupons to zero out the item instead of reducing it to $25.
quote: make them compound sequentially, applying each to the running amount

lesson: In apply_discounts, all percentage discounts must be applied before fixed-dollar discounts, ignoring the order in which coupons were submitted.
why: Evaluating coupons in submission order allowed customers to manipulate the sequence to their advantage and conflicted with finance's pricing model.
quote: Percent first, always. Then the fixed amount.
